title: 美债收益率24年新高：权益资产居然还在涨，市场结构早已失衡
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Many people don't find Treasury bonds, particularly interesting, but this really matters.
segments.zh: 很多人觉得国债没什么意思，但这其实很重要。

segments.en: The 10-year Treasury yield has recently broken through to its highest level in 24 years.
segments.zh: 10年期美债收益率近期突破24年来最高水平。

segments.en: As you can see from the chart, it's done it really quite suddenly and sharply.
segments.zh: 从图表可见，这次突破非常突然且急剧。

segments.en: Now, it's common for people to say that the 10-year yield is the most important number in global finance.
segments.zh: 人们常说，10年期收益率是全球金融中最重要的数字。

segments.en: Even though most of us don't actually own any 10-year Treasury bonds, it matters because it's the closest approach we have to a risk-free long-term investment.
segments.zh: 尽管我们大多数人并不持有10年期美债，但它重要是因为它最接近无风险长期**。

segments.en: Uncle Sam will repay that debt, and that means it becomes the effective risk-free rate that people assume when they're building any other transaction around the world.
segments.zh: 美国政府会偿还债务，因此它成为全球其他交易中假设的有效无风险利率。

segments.en: When the 10-year yield goes up, all other things equal, you can expect your mortgage rates to go up.
segments.zh: 当10年期收益率上升，其他条件不变时，你的按揭利率可能上升。

segments.en: You can expect if you're a company, the rate at which you can borrow to go up.
segments.zh: 如果你是一家公司，你的借款利率也可能上升。

segments.en: That could be good news. It stops the economy from overheating.
segments.zh: 这可能是好消息，能防止经济过热。

segments.en: It stops greed from running rampant, but it should all else equal mean problems for the stock market.
segments.zh: 它能阻止贪婪蔓延，但其他条件不变时，这应对权益资产市场意味着问题。

segments.en: That hasn't happened this time at all.
segments.zh: 这次完全没有出现这种情况。

segments.en: Now, why are stocks hitting all-time highs?
segments.zh: 那么，为什么权益资产在创新高？

segments.en: In large part because the stock market is now very unbalanced.
segments.zh: 很大程度上是因为市场现在非常不平衡。

segments.en: Now, what this table shows you is the stocks that have added and subtracted the most in terms of points.
segments.zh: 这张表展示的是点数贡献最大和拖累最多的权益资产。
